control.description-key: Replacement for the Turn-In Business Process Flow bar. Renders a chevron-style progress bar (State Approval, optionally BE Approval, Approved) with role-gated Approve/Deny buttons. The BE Approval stage is hidden when book_requiresbeapproval is No. Role checks (State Approver / State Administrator / Checkbook Administrator for State; Budget Executor / Checkbook Administrator for BE) are mirrored in TurnInValidator as the authoritative security boundary.

property.name: turnInName
property.description-key: Field the control is placed on. Value is unused.
